locations.note: The game opens with Powell's Rangers raiding Arzew during Operation Torch in November 1942.
Powell infiltrates a U-boat base at Trondheim to sabotage a submarine before it sails.
The famous D-Day mission lands Lt. Powell on Omaha Beach under fire from the bluffs.
Behind enemy lines in the bocage between Omaha Beach and Carentan, Powell raids a manor house used as a command post and destroys a Nebelwerfer battery.
Powell hijacks a King Tiger tank and uses it to secure a vital bridge at Brest.
The final mission storms Fort Schmerzen, an invented mustard-gas plant on the Siegfried Line, to free its prisoners.

routes.name: Powell's war
routes.note: From Operation Torch in 1942 to the Siegfried Line in 1944.
